explication: Coldcard is a Bitcoin hardware wallet whose firmware guides users through PIN login and wallet operations, authorizes sensitive actions such as transaction signing, and uses device storage and hardware security to protect secrets. The README describes shared high-level code running on both the desktop simulator and embedded hardware, with Mk and Q variants. Major capabilities are represented from the README and source index; unsampled implementation details and external-service wiring are not inferred.
